authorization: User: Continue. Add shape to the ground to create rolling ground. Find extra elements to add to the scene based off of concept art and elements from the area.
scope: New explicitly authorized representation/terrain/dressing study; prior failed ground study remains unchanged as historical evidence.
reviewer: Primary agent; actual reference, hero, elevated and holdout images interpreted. No independent review.

rounds.hypothesis: Stronger rolls plus a continuous low surface and source-integrated grass/flora supply missing volume.
rounds.finding: Human view still too bare; grass distribution distant and staging height mask too broad. Initial flower shader type mismatch fixed before artistic review.

rounds.hypothesis: Natural broad shoulders plus redirected existing instances along near sides improve silhouette and stage visibility.
rounds.finding: Rolling slopes and flower pockets visibly improve, but broad brush cards read as repeated short terraces.
rounds.decision: retain terrain/dressing; reject grass shape as final

rounds.hypothesis: Recovering atlas contrast might restore painted grass volume; replace arrow-like seedheads with fine branching panicles.
rounds.finding: Extra contrast makes card boundaries more conspicuous. New seedheads and shrub illumination are preferable.
rounds.decision: reject stronger grass contrast; retain seed/shrub improvements

rollback.decision: Disable failed near/middle brush-card batches by default, preserving them under prairieBrush=1 for explicit negative comparison. Retain terrain, continuous low surface, actual curved grass, fine seedheads, forbs and sparse shrubs. This rollback is not another correction round.

holdout.finding: Rolling shape and flora variation survive. Foreground remains lawn-like and one shoulder closes more of the distant view. Record as limitation, not artistic approval.

remaining.defect: No accepted dense prairie-grass representation. Broad brush cards fail at this view and are off by default.
Near surface is still too lawn-like and too sparsely dimensional relative to concept.
Forbs/shrubs are simplified functional forms, not production botanical assets.
Holdout shoulder reduces long-distance openness; source was not retuned after seeing it.

reusableRules.principle: Terrain shoulders and vegetation-height falloff should be judged together at human height; elevated views can conceal a barren foreground.
Keep one pigment sampler for grass roots and the ground, but do not treat matching color as proof of a good silhouette.
A broad soft brush atlas is automatically a suitable grass representation in another biome.
reusableRules.reason: Repeated flat terraces remain apparent despite correct alpha and root pigment. More contrast worsens them.

approval: No human artistic approval, global promotion, commit, push or deployment.
